payout_quote: Example, 1 delivery, $100 gross: Instant Pay | Occupational Accident Insurance Fee $0.65 | Instant Pay Fee $1.00 + $1.50 (1.5%) | Total Fees $3.15 | Net Payout $96.85. You can choose Instant Pay on a per-payout basis any time you have a debit card or bank account on file, or simply do nothing and receive your free Weekly Payout every Wednesday.
timing: Per-payout choice in the app; free weekly payout every Wednesday (cutoff Wednesday 10:59:59 AM Pacific). Official guide says after an Instant Pay request 'you should see your funds soon' (exact minutes not quantified on the page).
eligibility: Curri driver with a debit card or bank account on file; Stripe determines instant eligibility per method (ineligible methods fall back to the free weekly payout).
steps: Add a debit card or bank account as your payout method in the Curri app.
When a payout is available, choose Instant Pay for that payout (or do nothing for the free Wednesday weekly payout).
Confirm; the $1.00 + 1.5% Instant Pay fee and $0.65 per-delivery insurance fee are deducted automatically.
catches: Instant Pay fee is $1.00 + 1.5% of the payout, on top of the $0.65 occupational accident insurance fee charged per completed delivery on every payout (weekly included).
The official guide does not quantify exact arrival time beyond 'you should see your funds soon'.
Stripe decides whether each card or bank account is instant-eligible; ineligible methods show as ineligible in the app.
Pay varies by market and demand; fuel, maintenance, insurance, tolls and other vehicle costs reduce net earnings.
No delivery-count promotion is quoted on the official page.
biggest_catch: Every payout carries the $0.65 per-delivery insurance fee, and choosing Instant Pay adds $1.00 + 1.5% on top: a $100 single-delivery instant payout nets $96.85, and frequent instant cashouts stack both fees every time.

who_pays: Curri pays your delivery earnings, and Stripe decides per payout method whether Instant Pay is offered - instant-eligible debit cards and bank accounts get the instant option. If your method is not instant-eligible, you fall back to Curri's free weekly payout.
who_qualifies: You need to be an active Curri driver with a debit card or bank account on file; Stripe checks each method and marks it instant-eligible or not. Curri's official requirements also include being 18 or older, holding a valid non-provisional license, a sedan/pickup/van you are qualified to drive, auto insurance, and passing motor-vehicle and criminal background checks.
work_available: Deliveries are posted near your location and vary with customer demand - Curri offers one-off hotshots plus regular and daily routes, but nothing is guaranteed. The official payout guide promises no minimum work; your volume depends on construction-delivery demand in your area.
what_gets_accepted: You are paid per delivery you complete; incomplete or canceled deliveries do not pay. Curri publishes no exact rating threshold tied to instant payouts in the official payout guide - that part is unverified.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Every payout carries a $0.65 occupational accident insurance fee per completed delivery - including the free weekly payout - and Instant Pay adds $1.00 + 1.5% of the payout on top, so a $100 single-delivery instant payout nets $96.85. Your fuel, maintenance, tolls, and insurance come out of your pocket, and time waiting for jobs, driving unpaid to pickups, and onboarding is unpaid: only completed deliveries pay.
when_cash_arrives: Choose Instant Pay on a per-payout basis whenever cash is available and the funds should show up soon - the official guide does not quantify exact minutes. The default is a free weekly payout every Wednesday (cutoff Wednesday 10:59:59 AM Pacific), and if your card or bank account is not instant-eligible, Stripe only offers you the weekly option.
